title.en: Split in Two with Raw Pointers

tests.code: let mut v = [1, 2, 3]; let (a, b) = split_pair(&mut v, 1); a[0] = 7; b[1] = 9; assert_eq!(v, [7, 2, 9]);
let mut v = [1, 2]; let (a, b) = split_pair(&mut v, 2); assert_eq!(a.len(), 2); assert!(b.is_empty());
let mut v = [1]; let r = std::panic::catch_unwind(std::panic::AssertUnwindSafe(|| { split_pair(&mut v, 2); })); assert!(r.is_err());
